# kawasy context corpus (ISUCON2026 user harness and related public materials)

This is a static, AI-readable research corpus about Yoshinori Kawasaki (@kawasy, luvtechno), focused on the ISUCON2026 winning autonomous user harness and his public talks, articles, posts, and interviews.

- Human index: ./index.html
- Full combined context (give this URL to an AI): ./context.md
- Same corpus alias: ./llms-full.txt
- Machine catalog: ./data/sources.json
- Posts catalog: ./data/posts.json
- Harness summary: ./pages/harness.html
- What is not published: ./pages/unpublished.html
- Timeline: ./pages/timeline.html

Copyright: do not treat this site as a substitute for the originals. Full third-party articles and full transcripts of other people's programs are not republished here. Public pages have metadata, original URLs, detailed Japanese summaries, timestamped points, and short quotes. Full transcripts are stored privately off the public tree.

Last-updated: 2026-11-15 22:57 (Asia/Tokyo)
